qe: The Great Bath is an important archaeological structure at which Harappan site?
qh: महान स्नानागार किस हड़प्पा स्थल की प्रमुख पुरातात्विक संरचना है?
e: The Great Bath was discovered at Mohenjo-daro in present-day Pakistan.

qe: Which feature is associated with the planned cities of the Harappan civilisation?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता के नियोजित नगरों की एक विशेषता कौन-सी थी?
oh: पकी ईंटों का बिल्कुल उपयोग नहीं
कहीं भी कुओं के बिना घर
e: Many Harappan settlements had planned streets, baked-brick buildings and drainage systems.

qe: Ashoka was a ruler of which ancient dynasty?
qh: अशोक किस प्राचीन राजवंश का शासक था?
e: Ashoka was a Mauryan emperor.

qe: The Kalinga War was fought in a region that is mainly in which present-day state?
qh: कलिंग युद्ध का क्षेत्र मुख्यतः वर्तमान के किस राज्य में पड़ता है?
e: Ancient Kalinga covered much of present-day Odisha and adjoining areas.

qe: Many of Ashoka's rock and pillar inscriptions were written in which script?
qh: अशोक के अनेक शिलालेख और स्तंभलेख किस लिपि में लिखे गए थे?
e: Most Ashokan inscriptions in the Indian subcontinent used Brahmi; some north-western inscriptions used Kharosthi.

qe: The ancient political treatise 'Arthashastra' is traditionally associated with whom?
qh: प्राचीन राजनीतिक ग्रंथ 'अर्थशास्त्र' परंपरागत रूप से किससे जुड़ा है?
e: The Arthashastra is traditionally attributed to Kautilya, also known as Chanakya.

qe: Which poet and dramatist is associated with the classical Gupta-age Sanskrit tradition?
qh: गुप्तकालीन संस्कृत साहित्य-परंपरा से कौन-से कवि और नाटककार जुड़े हैं?
e: Kalidasa is one of the best-known classical Sanskrit poets and dramatists.

qe: Who is generally regarded as the founder of the Delhi Sultanate's Mamluk (Slave) dynasty?
qh: दिल्ली सल्तनत के मामलुक (गुलाम) वंश का संस्थापक सामान्यतः किसे माना जाता है?
e: Qutb-ud-din Aibak established the Mamluk dynasty in Delhi in 1206.

qe: Which Bhakti poet is especially known for couplets questioning social divisions and hypocrisy?
qh: सामाजिक भेदभाव और पाखंड पर प्रश्न उठाने वाले दोहों के लिए कौन-से भक्त कवि प्रसिद्ध हैं?
e: Kabir's poetry is known for challenging ritualism and social divisions.

qe: Who founded the Mughal Empire in India after the First Battle of Panipat in 1526?
qh: 1526 के पानीपत के प्रथम युद्ध के बाद भारत में मुगल साम्राज्य की स्थापना किसने की?
e: Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi at Panipat in 1526 and established Mughal rule in northern India.

qe: Which Mughal emperor introduced the religious discussion known as the Ibadat Khana at Fatehpur Sikri?
qh: फतेहपुर सीकरी में इबादतखाना में धार्मिक चर्चा किस मुगल सम्राट ने शुरू की?
e: Akbar built the Ibadat Khana at Fatehpur Sikri for religious discussions.

qe: The Maratha kingdom in western India is closely associated with which ruler?
qh: पश्चिमी भारत के मराठा राज्य का विशेष संबंध किस शासक से है?
e: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj established and expanded the Maratha kingdom.

qe: Rani Lakshmibai was the queen of which princely state during the uprising of 1857?
qh: 1857 के विद्रोह के समय रानी लक्ष्मीबाई किस रियासत की रानी थीं?
e: Rani Lakshmibai was the queen of Jhansi.

qe: In which year was the Indian National Congress founded?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस की स्थापना किस वर्ष हुई?
e: The Indian National Congress was founded in 1885.

qe: The partition of Bengal announced by Lord Curzon took effect in which year?
qh: लॉर्ड कर्ज़न द्वारा घोषित बंगाल विभाजन किस वर्ष लागू हुआ?
e: The partition of Bengal took effect in 1905 and was annulled in 1911.

qe: Where did Mahatma Gandhi lead his first major satyagraha in India in 1917?
qh: 1917 में महात्मा गांधी ने भारत में अपना पहला बड़ा सत्याग्रह कहाँ चलाया?
e: Gandhi led the Champaran Satyagraha in Bihar in 1917.

qe: The Dandi March of 1930 protested against which colonial policy?
qh: 1930 का दांडी मार्च किस औपनिवेशिक नीति के विरोध में था?
e: Gandhi's Salt March challenged the British salt tax and monopoly.

qe: In which year did the Quit India Movement begin?
qh: भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन किस वर्ष शुरू हुआ?
e: The Quit India Movement was launched in August 1942.

qe: Who gave leadership to the Indian National Army in its later phase and popularised the call 'Jai Hind'?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय सेना के बाद के चरण का नेतृत्व किसने किया और 'जय हिंद' के नारे को लोकप्रिय बनाया?
e: Subhas Chandra Bose led the INA in its later phase and popularised 'Jai Hind'.

qe: The French Revolution began in which year?
qh: फ्रांसीसी क्रांति किस वर्ष शुरू हुई?
e: The French Revolution began in 1789.

qe: In which country did the Industrial Revolution first begin?
qh: औद्योगिक क्रांति सबसे पहले किस देश में शुरू हुई?
e: The Industrial Revolution began in Britain in the eighteenth century.

qe: World War I began in which year?
qh: प्रथम विश्व युद्ध किस वर्ष शुरू हुआ?
e: World War I began in 1914 and ended in 1918.

qe: In which year did World War II end?
qh: द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध किस वर्ष समाप्त हुआ?
e: World War II ended in 1945.

qe: Which ancient Greek city is often associated with the early development of democracy?
qh: किस प्राचीन यूनानी नगर का संबंध लोकतंत्र के प्रारंभिक विकास से जोड़ा जाता है?
e: Athens developed an early form of direct democracy, though participation was limited.

qe: The Silk Road was an important network for trade between which broad regions?
qh: रेशम मार्ग किन व्यापक क्षेत्रों के बीच व्यापार का महत्वपूर्ण मार्ग था?
e: The Silk Road connected traders and communities across Asia and Europe.

qe: Who campaigned against the practice of sati and founded the Brahmo Sabha?
qh: सती प्रथा के विरोध में अभियान चलाने और ब्रह्म सभा स्थापित करने वाले कौन थे?
e: Raja Ram Mohan Roy campaigned against sati and founded the Brahmo Sabha in 1828.

qe: Which law was passed in 1919 and allowed the colonial government to detain people without trial?
qh: 1919 में पारित किस कानून से औपनिवेशिक सरकार को बिना मुकदमे लोगों को हिरासत में रखने की शक्ति मिली?
e: The Rowlatt Act of 1919 allowed detention without trial and provoked widespread protest.

qe: Which slogan is associated with the 1942 Quit India Movement?
qh: 1942 के भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन से कौन-सा नारा जुड़ा है?
e: Gandhi gave the call 'Do or Die' during the Quit India Movement.

qe: The Constitution of India was adopted by the Constituent Assembly in which year?
qh: संविधान सभा ने भारत का संविधान किस वर्ष अंगीकृत किया?
e: The Constituent Assembly adopted the Constitution in 1949; it came into force in 1950.

qe: In which year did India become independent from British rule?
qh: भारत ब्रिटिश शासन से किस वर्ष स्वतंत्र हुआ?
e: India became independent on 15 August 1947.
